name: Bowen Scarff Ford
about: At Bowen Scarff Ford, we’re a family-owned dealership proudly serving the Pacific Northwest since 1958. For over 65 years, we’ve offered a hassle-free, pressure-free buying experience with non-commissioned, certified Ford experts dedicated to helping you find the perfect vehicle. As a 5-star rated dealership and multi-year Dealer Rater Consumer Satisfaction Award winner (2020–2025), we’re also 17-time recipients of the Ford President’s Award—proof of our lasting commitment to trust, service, and customer satisfaction.

detail_reviews.author: sfguyer
detail_reviews.text:
We had a great experience working with Chris Kelly on the purchase of our car. Chris was helpful from my first internet inquiry all the way through providing the details we needed to make our decision.

We were able to work through most of the details and agree on terms before ever stepping onto the lot, and Chris held the car for us until we could get there. That made the entire process much easier and more efficient.

Once we arrived, the purchase was quick and straightforward with no unnecessary hassle. This was also my son’s first time going through the car-buying process, and Chris did a great job helping him understand how everything worked.

Overall, it was a very positive experience. I appreciated Chris’s communication, professionalism, and making the entire purchase as easy as possible.

detail_reviews.author: mjtaguinaldo14
detail_reviews.text: Chris and his team help me get approved for a new car. They were helpful and approachable. This new loan will set me up for good in the future. So go on and meet them at bowen ford kent. Im sure they'll take care of you too.  Goodbless.

detail_reviews.author: Lynnafranklin60
detail_reviews.text: Today I brought home a truck that I purchased from Brandon Hopper at this dealership in Kent. It was a positive experience from beginning to end. It was no-nonsense, no game playing, a kind and professional sales rep. He was knowledgeable, we went the extra mile, great communication, I can’t say enough good things!!!! It was worth the longer drive to purchase this truck from Brandon.

detail_reviews.author: NWVicki
detail_reviews.text:
A big thank you to Chris Kelly for a fabulous truck buying experience. We went in looking for a used truck. Chris helped us and answered lots of questions in an easy-going manner. It was just like talking to the guy next door. He was not high pressure, which we appreciated and would not have gone back if he was. Instead, after we left, we decided to order a new truck that would fit our exact specifications so we called Chris and let him know. He easily walked us through the process and answered questions along the way. Of course, when the truck finally arrived from Ford, it was over the top perfect. We love it.
If you’re in the market for a Ford vehicle, I highly recommend Chris Kelly, he is reliable and very easy to work with.
The finance manager, Chris Wright, is also fabulous. He explained all the additional options, answered all of our questions, is very knowledgeable, and again, not high pressure which we appreciated. Thank you to both Chris and Chris!

detail_reviews.author: Greg
detail_reviews.text: Great overall experience, Chris Kelly (our salesman) was the best, same with Christopher Right (finance guy) were personable and easy to talk to and understand. Not at all a xxxxx experience like other dealerships we’ve been to. Would definitely recommend and buy from again with confidence. Thanks Again for making our purchase an enjoyable event.

detail_reviews.author: DebbieinSeattle
detail_reviews.text: I always dread going to a car dealer, and the haggling that it involves. So I was pleasantly surprised to find that haggling was not involved! The price was fair, our sales rep Chris Kelly was very pleasant and helpful, and he made the purchase process painless.  Rob also was helpful and NOT pushy when talking with us about a service contract and other add-ons.  There was no pressure to add a service that I did not think I needed.  Chris followed up a few days later to make sure all was well with the car and that I had no additional questions. I would definitely go back to Bowen Scarff for another car purchase.

detail_reviews.author: alujohnson
detail_reviews.text: Jason Granstrand was my salesperson, and he was most helpful with helping to find a truck to purchase. His patience and consideration when we decided not to purchase the truck made this buying experience more of a learning experience and that I will consider going back to work with Jason when I am prepared to make this purchase.

detail_reviews.author: terimarquez38
detail_reviews.text: Chris was not only helpful but went above and beyond when it was time this Mom finally got her dream truck, went in to check out the F150 King Ranch. Drove the king Ranch but didnt feel the super drive vibes, then went over and test drove the F150 Raptor. Wow, the feel of a big nice truck and the comfort and and cant forget About the Power. Wow, just wow. Momma got her Dream Truck. Thanks Chris, for your patients and your knowledgeable expertise on these trucks. Mom is Extremely Happy.

detail_reviews.author: Mel.F
detail_reviews.text: I requested info about a car through a third party website and Chris Kelly was the one to reply to my inquiry. He was very quick with his responses and made me a walk-through video of the car immediately without me even having to ask. Once we decided to come test drive the car, he had it ready and waiting when we pulled up to the dealership. We decided to purchase, and he made the experience easy, relatively quick and painless. Chris was really knowledgeable, even sharing some of his personal experiences with aftermarket accessories for his own car. He was great to work with! Thanks, Chris!

detail_reviews.author: jen
detail_reviews.text: These guys are great. First of all, they KNOW the cars they sell. There wasn't a single question I asked that they couldn't answer. Secondly, they aren't a high pressure dealer. I got a fair price on an amazing SUV. All the stuff other dealers try to up-charge you for (Nitrogen tire fills, clear coating, etc.) came free from these guys. Jason, Brandon, and Rob were all fantastic. When you go there, ask for any of these guys and you'll be treated right.

detail_reviews.author: Shane
detail_reviews.text: Alan was amazing. He was straightforward and didn't waste my time. Bought my Bronco over the phone from him and everything was exactly the way he described it. detail_reviews.author: Michael Ellison
detail_reviews.text: Buying cars for me is like having a root canal. No matter how much research you do or bargain hard you will usually get screwed. They do this everyday and know all the sleazy tricks. Alan was different for me. Went to ParkPlace just to look at a car and sit in it before negotiating with a new car dealer. Fell in love with the car and working with Alan who made the experience feel good and did not use pressure or any of the other tricks you get at most dealerships. Thanks to Alan, an enjoyable experience.

detail_reviews.author: S.akins350z
detail_reviews.text: Park Place LTD is an amazing dealership. With everything you could hope for in a car buying experience. The best people with extensive knowledge on everything you want to know about all of the vehicles they have on the lot and even ones they don’t, they will assist you to get what you want. The friendliest service I have ever had! They have the most amazing cars, it’s like being at a luxury and sports car mall or museum! I love my new car I bought from Park Place LTD and I would look forward to buying my next one from them as well. Thanks Alan.

detail_reviews.author: sleach50
detail_reviews.text:
I have been working with David Khazai since the late 1990s.  During that time I have purchased a total of 7 cars from him.  One of the reasons I continue to purchase cars from him is he is honest and operates with integrity.  If he can't meet my request then he will be upfront and honest.  If he says he will do something then he honors his commitment.

The other reason I love working with David is he embodies the values of Park Place: Humble, Inviting, Relational, Driven, and Passionate.  These values accurately describe all of my interactions with David.  If anyone is looking for a car then I highly recommend you start at Park Place and you seek out David Khazai.

detail_reviews.author: Jimw1138
detail_reviews.text: An extremely good experience.  Even though it was 6pm he took the time to show me the car and answer my questions. No rush to get me out at all (unlike the experience I’ve had before). He invested the time for a great experience for me and my wife ensuring everything we needed was taken care of. I especially appreciated the time he took with my wife ensuring she was comfortable with the purchase. In the end, I got the car of my dreams in record time with no hassle and complete professionalism.

detail_reviews.author: Brent Crowder
detail_reviews.text: David was very professional went out of his way to make us feel good about our purchase. We bought an absolutely beautiful car had a few hiccups, but him and his general manager went out of their way to make everything good. I would buy another car from these guys in a heartbeat and recommend anybody to them. Great job you guys. Thank you for the cool car.

He was patient and professional throughout the entire process.  I bought the exact vehicle I wanted, and it was shipped to my house seamlessly.

name: Ron Tonkin Honda
about: Ron Tonkin Honda is 100% committed to our customers’ satisfaction and sells and leases new Hondas, including Civics, Accords, Fits, CR-Vs, HR-Vs, Pilots, Odysseys and Ridgeline pickups. We also sell top-quality used cars and provide repair and service for all makes and models. Every member of our team is responsible for making your experience at Ron Tonkin Honda the best it can be, and we strive to give you the best customer experience possible.For those drivers seeking a great car loan or Honda lease in Portland, our auto financing staff can discuss the loan application process and review special offers for additional savings. And when you purchase a car from Ron Tonkin Honda, you can take advantage of our reliable Honda auto repair center and a fully-stocked inventory of Honda car parts. Ron Tonkin Honda is located in Portland, Oregon at 300 SE 122nd Avenue Portland, OR. We’re Oregon’s top Honda dealer and we serve multiple regions, including Gresham, Beaverton, Hillsboro, Tigard, West Linn, Happy Valley and Vancouver Washington.

detail_reviews.author: hungkie
detail_reviews.text: I dropped off my car for repair at the dealer with the estimate time of 2 hours, but they could finish early 30min.  Very good Service and Nice Customer Suport.  Gary provided Great services.  Thank you very much !

detail_reviews.author: melnichukjohn
detail_reviews.text: Excellent service..polite knowledgeable fast ..accommodating flexible  helpful,friendly courteous phone friendly,good test dribe.

detail_reviews.author: UncleSpuddy
detail_reviews.text:
Avoid this place if you can.  Brought our HRV in late last year for scheduled maintenance.  Back the. They were nice and honest.  Paid for a Lift ride to and from my home while the work was done.   As they say, that was then and this is now.  

Yesterday, same type of visit.  Scheduled maintenance.  They tried to upsell for stuff not needed.  But they paid for a Lift ride home.  However, they wouldn’t pay for the lift ride back to the dealership!   I had no mode of transportation and they knew it.  I would have waited at the dealership had I known this.  The work only took an hour (was told it would take longer) and they charged $202 for labor alone.  

Done with anything that has the Tonkin name on it    As is the rest of my family.

detail_reviews.author: patty12526
detail_reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience with the entire team at Ron Tonkin Honda. Victoria Latrini was my salesperson, and from the beginning she was friendly, professional, and genuinely interested in helping me find the right car rather than simply making a sale.

I was looking for a 2026 Honda Civic Sport in one of two specific colors, and Victoria worked hard to make that happen. She kept me updated throughout the search and was always responsive and helpful. Jason also went above and beyond to locate the exact vehicle I wanted and get it to the dealership.

Once my car arrived, the entire purchase process was easy and enjoyable. Kyle handled the final transaction quickly and professionally. Everyone I encountered was friendly, eager to help, and respectful of my choices. I never felt pressured to settle for a vehicle or purchase anything I wasn't completely happy with.

After 27 years since my last new-car purchase, I couldn't have asked for a better experience. I highly recommend Ron Tonkin Honda, and especially Victoria Latrini. If you're looking for a Honda, I would absolutely recommend asking for her!

detail_reviews.author: briscoeucla
detail_reviews.text: Despite being 44 years old, this was actually my first time buying a car.  The dealership was very accommodating, but Niketo in particular, was especially great. He was professional and honest when working with me, but most of all, he was patient.  I told him this was my first time with a purchase sue as this, and he was willing to slow things down, answer endless questions, and work with me to find the right fit.  The punchline is: he didn't make me feel like a fool - he made me feel welcome, and for that, I will always be grateful.  I had interactions with a number of employees at this Honda location, but Niketo was the point man, and he was everything one would hope for as a guide in what can feel like an overwhelming endeavor.

detail_reviews.author: spencer.reynolds3
detail_reviews.text: The purchasing experience here was the smoothest I've ever had at a dealership. I never felt pressured to do anything I didn't want to do. Marco was helpful and patient. Many thanks!

detail_reviews.author: bigbry1031
detail_reviews.text: Everyone was great, from our salesman, Marco to the Sales Manager, Zach and the finance manager, Jeremy.  They all did a great job explaining everything and getting me on my way in my new Honda Accord.....thanks guys

detail_reviews.author: Erik Montague
detail_reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience with Ron Tonkin Honda’s service department.

For years, I trusted this dealership with my 2015 Honda Civic and paid dealership prices because I believed I was receiving expert service. Unfortunately, my recent experience has seriously damaged that trust.

In 2024, I followed the dealership’s recommended maintenance schedule and had a transmission fluid service performed. Shortly after that service, I began noticing transmission slipping and hesitation that had never been present before.

Over the next year and a half, I brought these concerns to the dealership multiple times. Each time, I was told everything appeared normal. At one visit, I was told the fluid was slightly low and was topped off, but the symptoms continued.

We received a call from Angel, the service manager, who informed us they had also discovered a P207F (DEF quality code) and the cause was contaminated DEF in our truck's DEF tank. Evelyn and Kharmin, the Dynamic Duo so rare,
I called with a dream and a hopeful prayer.

To Kharmin I left a message quite bold,
A Navarra Q3 at a price of pure gold.
Fearless and kind, Kharmin called me right back,
And set me on course for the perfect track.

The next day I arrived, and what did I see?
Evelyn waiting at the welcome desk for me.
Who does that these days? It truly stood out,
A warm first impression without any doubt.

Then there it was, shining bright in the sun,
A gorgeous Navarra Q3—my search was done.
Parked by the showroom, sparkling and clean,
Freshly washed and more beautiful than I'd seen.

For two hours Evelyn guided the way,
Making the experience special that day.
We even drove home for a practical test,
To see if my tiny garage would do its best.

With confidence and skill, Evelyn pulled right in,
Proving my dream SUV was destined to win.
The very next day I called with delight,
And purchased my dream car—everything felt right.

So here's to the Dynamic Duo, exceptional and true,
For turning a hopeful wish into a dream come true!

detail_reviews.text:
Sometimes the salesman really makes all the difference in the world. 

I've hated car dealerships since I was a kid. So When my car was totaled by a dude paying no attention for his yield left turn, I was very unenthused to make my way to energy auto sales to look at used cars within the budget of the insurance replacement. 

We came looking for a sedan of similar capabilities to the car I lost but it was square peg round hole enough that even Vasco, energys sales guy picked up on it. But this is where a great salesman made all the difference in both our experience and my opinion. Vaso listened to our story, really listened, and conversed with us until he found us in a suv. If someone'd told me that I'd be leaving with an suv I'd have laughed at their absurdity. 

But Vasco listened, Vasco suggested, and he was right. My wife had wanted an SUV for years, but it never felt like the right time. Now she has left happy with a dream come true, I have left happier as it feels like I'm not an the exit side of this accident (that i couldn't have avoided) with a car payment for something equal or lesser to what I had already paid off prior to the accident. 

And all for a price and

detail_reviews.author: Max B
detail_reviews.text:
I’ve had my fair share of service visits with my Panamera, and at this point I’m pretty sure the car has Matt on speed dial. 😂

detail_reviews.author: rlvernon42
detail_reviews.text:
Came in for a oil service on my 2022 Jeep Wrangler 2 Door. The Service Advisor (Mr. Jacobs) pointed out that based upon my time and mileage since last service, it would be appropriate to perform the 15,000 mile service and inspections at this time. This included the oil change and multi-point inspection, replacement of various filters, tire rotation and an alignment check, which is recommended to be re-done annually.
That all seemed like a good idea, and when the work was complete, I headed out for home in North Bend. Before I even got on the freeway, I knew the car was running better than when I drove in. Better acceleration, better steering responsiveness. And when I got over to I-90 between Issaquah and North Bend, the places in the lanes where the weight of the trucks have worn grooves in the lanes usually throws the Jeep back and forth, the steering being very twitchy and challenging at times. Now it took very little effort to track where I wanted to go. Whatever adjustments were made to the alignment, it is more fun to drive and feels safer too.
Thanks, Rairdon Jeep Service Department and Service Advisor Jacobs.
